GSC still records clicks daily through 2026-08-04, so the site is being visited — what stopped is GA4 collection, not traffic. The 28-day GA4 totals above are therefore an UNDER-COUNT and must not be read as a traffic decline. / Kiểm tra tag chạy trên một profile trình duyệt; chưa loại trừ hoàn toàn khả năng bị extension chặn. root_cause.summary: Script #dx-analytics-dedupe của chính site ghi đè Node.prototype.insertBefore để chặn trùng lặp googletagmanager.com/gtm.js, nhưng bật cờ window.__dxGtmLoaded = true mà không thực sự chèn thẻ script — nên cả 4 bản snippet GTM đều không chạy. / The site's own #dx-analytics-dedupe script overrides Node.prototype.insertBefore to de-duplicate googletagmanager.com/gtm.js, but sets window.__dxGtmLoaded = true without actually inserting the script tag — so none of the 4 GTM snippets ever load.

ad_blocker_ruled_out.reasoning: Một extension chặn quảng cáo sẽ chặn cả Meta Pixel lẫn GTM; Meta Pixel vẫn chạy nên đây là code của site. / A blocker extension would stop both the Meta Pixel and GTM; the Pixel still runs, so this is site code.

root_cause.why_ga4_went_to_zero: GA4 nạp hoàn toàn qua GTM, không có gtag/js trực tiếp (window.gtag undefined) — GTM chết thì GA4 chết theo, còn Meta Pixel gắn cứng riêng nên vẫn sống. / GA4 is delivered entirely through GTM with no direct gtag/js (window.gtag undefined) — killing GTM kills GA4, while the separately hard-coded Meta Pixel survives.
fix: Xoá hẳn script #dx-analytics-dedupe / Delete the #dx-analytics-dedupe script
Xoá 3 trong 4 bản snippet GTM, giữ đúng 1 bản trong <head> kèm <noscript> / Remove 3 of the 4 GTM snippets, keep exactly one in <head> with its <noscript>
Kiểm chứng: window.google_tag_manager khác undefined, Network có request gtm.js, GA4 DebugView nhận hit / Verify: window.google_tag_manager defined, a gtm.js request in Network, hits in GA4 DebugView

en: GSC window 8 Jul→4 Aug (counted all 28 rows in the Days tab to get the exact total instead of the rounded '1.29K' tile): clicks 68→72, impressions 1,189→1,288, queries-with-impressions 105→128. CTR 5.7%→5.6% and average position slipped 26.2→29.6 — still the shape of non-brand coverage widening at low ranks.

MEASUREMENT ALERT — GA4 stopped collecting around 29 Jul. Measured: 29–30 Jul = 0 sessions, 31 Jul–6 Aug = 1 session, against 5 for 26–28 Jul and 72 for 22 Jul–6 Aug. Realtime showed 0 active users. Checked on the live homepage: the string GTM-PZ9N8QTR is present in the markup but NO gtag/GTM script tag is loaded, window.dataLayer and window.gtag are both undefined, and no G- measurement ID appears. GSC still logs clicks every day through 4 Aug, so the site is being visited — what broke is the tracking. This is the first thing to fix.

GA4 ROOT CAUSE (traced 7 Aug, checked on the live site): the page carries 4 copies of the GTM-PZ9N8QTR snippet; the #dx-analytics-dedupe script overrides Node.prototype.insertBefore to de-duplicate them but sets window.__dxGtmLoaded = true WITHOUT inserting the script tag — the first copy is swallowed and the other three are skipped, so none ever load. Measured: inserting gtm.js into a detached node = 0 nodes (an ordinary script = 1 node), 0 requests to googletagmanager.com, google_tag_manager undefined, dataLayer holds a single 'gtm.js' entry. Not an ad blocker: the Meta Pixel still loads (3 requests). GA4 is delivered entirely through GTM (no direct gtag/js), so killing GTM kills GA4. Fix: delete #dx-analytics-dedupe and remove 3 duplicate snippets, keeping one.

CONSEQUENTLY: every 28-day GA4 figure in this snapshot (sessions 287, engaged 194, key events 23, users 140, total events 2,099) is an under-count and must not be read as a traffic decline. Comparing it with 3 Aug (381/256/38) is meaningless as a business signal.
AI assistant channel: 1 session from chatgpt.com / ai-assistant (0.35% of total), 100% engagement, 15 seconds, 0 key events — also inside the window affected by the tracking fault.

Ahrefs grew steadily: referring domains 352→366 (all-time 381), backlinks 357→372 (all-time 397), Health Score held at 100 (crawl at 04:16 today, 15 URLs, 0 errors). DR still 0, organic keywords/traffic still 0.
AI citations flat at 19 (ChatGPT 11 across 3 pages, Copilot 8 across 2). AI Overviews, AI Mode, Gemini and Perplexity remain 0; Grok is paused by Ahrefs so it is recorded as null, not 0.

AI Visibility 16→26/100 — the entire gain comes from Technical readiness 4→9/10, because two long-standing blockers are cleared: the homepage now carries Organization + LocalBusiness JSON-LD, and /articles no longer times out (HTTP 200 in ~1.9s, server-rendered; article pages carry Article + BlogPosting + FAQPage). Still missing: llms.txt.

The other dimensions are unchanged because the underlying numbers are unchanged: Presence 2/10 (2 of 6 platforms), Citation surface 1/10 (3 pages), Measurement 1/10 (Brand Radar tracks 0 prompts — re-read today). Third-party corpus stays at 0/10 but was NOT re-tested today and is flagged as such.
